description: This file defines an interface for a grain in Orleans, providing methods for pinging, resetting, retrieving runtime ID, and proxy ping operations.

classes.name: ICommonDirectoryGrain
classes.description: Interface representing a directory grain with methods for health check and management operations.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Asynchronous method to check the availability of the grain.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Asynchronous method to reset the grain's state.

methods.name: GetRuntimeInstanceId
methods.description: Retrieves the unique identifier for the current grain instance.

methods.name: ProxyPing
methods.description: Performs a ping to another grain specified by the ICommonDirectoryGrain interface.
